subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers clear the dirty open fork PR as the fix path and allow a fresh current-main Control UI repair for this issue?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open fork PR still closes it while targeting obsolete code and reporting a dirty merge state.

options.title: Clear fork PR and queue fresh fix
options.body: Treat the fork PR as stale/unviable, then allow a narrow current-main fix with localization, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Wait for fork author
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the fork PR author rebasing and updating the implementation for the current Debug page split.

recommendation.title: Clear fork PR and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Treat the fork PR as stale/unviable, then allow a narrow current-main fix with localization, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Debug dashboard surface appears to come from Peter's dashboard expansion, and this is primarily a Control UI product-maintenance choice.
